R4A-bear-atv-0001.pressureWhy: Busier: under 30 minutes from a city (estimate).
R4A-bear-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Duhamel Creek FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2010 (16 years old), right here: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2022 (fire N72263), 310 m W: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
W facing slope, 21 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Duhamel Creek 20 m SW: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

plan: Drive: from City of Rossland, about 92 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).

Ride: 1.0 km on Duhamel Creek FSR by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 40 m N, climb about 0 m.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-18, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
